content.title: The Future of Energy: Innovation for Sustainable Development
content.cta: Scroll, tab or use your keyboard to move ahead

content.text:
This module explores the transformative potential of innovation in shaping the future of sustainable energy systems. It examines the key trends, technologies, and systemic shifts driving energy transitions globally, with a focus on the socioeconomic, geopolitical, and environmental forces influencing energy demand and supply.

Through critical analysis of enabling environments, emerging sectors, and practical solutions, the module equips learners to understand and navigate the complex landscape of energy innovation. Emphasizing inclusivity, resilience, and strategic foresight, it prepares UNDP practitioners to support innovation-driven transitions that are just, future-ready, and aligned with sustainable development goals.

content.title: Learning Objectives
content.intro: If you only have space to remember 4 things:

objectives.title: Provide learners with a forward-looking understanding of the key drivers shaping the future of energy systems, including global trends in demand, supply, digitalization, climate impacts, and geopolitical shifts.

Improve understanding in the challenges and structural barriers facing countries—particularly emerging economies—in achieving a just, inclusive, and resilient energy transition, including issues related to financing, infrastructure, land, and social acceptance.

Equip learners to critically assess the role of technological, financial, and policy innovations in accelerating sustainable energy transitions, while exploring opportunities to foster enabling environments and inclusive innovation ecosystems.
Empower learners to connect long-term energy innovation with development outcomes, including universal energy access, equity, local value creation, and climate-resilient futures.
